**What actually governs this determination:** Security Health Plan of Wisconsin does not appear to author its own medical-necessity policy for shoulder arthroscopic labral/instability repair. For "Joint Surgery" (hip, knee, and **shoulder**), Security Health Plan delegates prior-authorization medical necessity review to **eviCore by Evernorth**, which applies its own clinical guideline, **CMM‑315: Shoulder Surgery – Arthroscopic and Open Procedures**, part of eviCore's "Comprehensive Musculoskeletal Management (CMM) Guidelines."
